environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed in isolated VPC (no NAT, no IGW). The gRPC downstream service (internal-service.local:50051) is exposed exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with a VPC endpoint policy that restricts the 'invokeEndpoint' action to the Lambda execution role ARN only. The Lambda function URL is configured with AWS_IAM auth type (not API Gateway). Inbound requests require SigV4 signing with an IAM principal that has lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission scoped to this function ARN. The VPC has no internet-routable path — DNS resolution for the gRPC target goes through the interface endpoint's private DNS entry. Security group on the VPC endpoint ENI allows inbound 50051 only from the Lambda's security group CIDR. There is no public API Gateway integration; the function URL with IAM auth is the sole ingress path.
